topic: Fixing a filed return: wait for the notice of assessment, then change the return you filed (Change my return / ReFILE / T1-ADJ); refunds back 10 calendar years at CRA's discretion; interest on extra tax from May 1

example.note: example (not a CRA rule): Manitoba employee with taxable income about $70,000 (federal 20.5% band $58,523–$117,045, Manitoba 12.75% band $47,000–$100,000, 2026); case 1: $1,500 of union dues not claimed (deduction); case 2: a late T4A adds $3,000 of income with no tax withheld; both changes stay inside the same bands.

sources.wait_noa: canada.ca 'Change your return' (via search results 2026-10-13): wait until you receive your notice of assessment before requesting a change; wait for a response before requesting more changes; Change my return can't be used for 2014 or earlier
sources.routes: canada.ca tax tips (2021–2023) and 'How to fix a mistake on your tax return' infographic: Change my return (My Account), ReFILE, or Form T1-ADJ by mail; about 2 weeks online, about 8 weeks by mail
sources.ten_years: ITA 152(4.2): for a refund or reduction, an individual may apply on or before the day that is 10 calendar years after the end of the taxation year; the Minister MAY reassess (discretionary); CRA tip example: a 2022 request can cover 2012 or later
sources.interest: ITA 161(1) and 248(1): interest at the prescribed rate on unpaid tax after April 30 (balance-due day)
sources.union_dues: ITA 8(1)(i)(iv): annual union dues deductible from employment income
